items.title: 2 reasons why Microsoft belongs in your portfolio: D.A. Davidson's Gil Luria
items.summary: D.A. Davidson's Gil Luria joins Yahoo Finance's Josh Lipton to explain why Microsoft (MSFT) is a top AI stock, arguing that its multi-year access to OpenAI’s technology and the rise of open-source models make owning a proprietary frontier model unnecessary.

items.title: Could AMD's new Helios AI rack system push it to outperform Nvidia?
items.summary: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) unveiled its latest AI infrastructure product, the Helios rackscale systems for data centers. Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley outlines AMD's latest raft of microprocessors and other products that aim to put it in direct competition with chip competitor Nvidia (NVDA). AMD is currently scheduled to report second quarter earnings on Tuesday, August 4, well ahead of Nvidia's earnings release expected out on Wednesday, August 26.

items.title: SpaceX Has a $1.6 Trillion Opportunity That May Eclipse Its AI Business
items.summary: Starlink's fast-growing satellite connectivity business is likely the stronger long-term investment thesis if the company can scale it up.

items.title: Why Meta is My New Favorite to Win the AI Race
items.summary: Meta's AI strategy has quietly shifted from playing catch-up to raising the stakes in ways most analysts have yet to price in, and the CapEx fears dominating headlines may be obscuring something much bigger building beneath the surface.

items.title: Wall Street Slashes Tesla Price Targets After Its Q2 Miss, but Few Are Backing Away
items.summary: Tesla posted record deliveries and a massive revenue beat, yet watched $71 billion in market cap vanish overnight. What analysts are telling clients now about the road ahead reveals a striking split between the headline numbers and the real story inside the quarter.

items.title: Prediction: Apple Will Be a Long-Term AI Winner. 3 Reasons Why.
items.summary: Once critical about the company's slow AI push, investors have bid shares 22% higher in 2026.

items.title: Micron Stock Offers A Different Kind Of Return
items.summary: The memory chip maker's recent surge is tempting, but its long-term behavior against the market is what truly matters for your wealth.

items.title: Pullback in chip stocks is a buying opportunity, Citi says
items.summary: Investing.com -- The recent pullback in semiconductor stocks, driven by surging oil prices, rising bond yields and concerns over AI spending, represents a buying opportunity for the sector, Citi analysts say.
